title: Camouflaging Armour
description: This project adds a new texture to the diamond armor that has a military look and makes it harder to see and it also adds a new texture to the diamond sword which makes it look like a fighting knife. Good for role plays.
body: This project adds a new texture to the diamond armor that has a military look and makes it harder to see and it also adds a new texture to the diamond sword which makes it look like a fighting knife.
